crossRefs.note: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be…
For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

parallels.note: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

translations.web: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
translations.bsb: No one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
translations.asv: Let no man seek his own, but each his neighbor's good.
